card.name: Small words in study result reporting
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, by, the, on) or a space right before a measured outcome in clinical or experimental study results, as in "mean change in" or "as assessed by".

modes.label: Change in a measure
modes.description: The word "in" after "change" before a lab or weight value.
modes.example: had a mean change<< in>> weight of -0.02 kg

modes.label: Assessed by an instrument
modes.description: "by" or "the" after "assessed" or "evaluated" before a named scale or test.
modes.example: as assessed<< by>> questionnaire, was higher in

modes.description: A space after a comma in a description of an experiment's participant results.
